title: The water cycle
subject: Science
learningGoal: Trace water through evaporation, condensation, precipitation, and collection.
spokenLines: The water cycle. Water moves in a loop, powered by the sun.
First: evaporation. The sun heats liquid water and it rises as vapor.
Next: condensation. Cool air up high turns vapor into tiny droplets — clouds.
Then: precipitation. Droplets combine and fall as rain, snow, or hail.
Finally: collection. Water gathers in rivers, lakes, and oceans.
And then the sun evaporates it again. The loop keeps going forever.
